docs.title: README.md
docs.text:
To deploy changes:

uv run mkdocs serve - Start the live-reloading docs server.

uv run mkdocs gh-deploy - Build and push to GitHub gh-pages branch.

docs.title: Setup
docs.text:
uv add mkdocs mkdocs-material
uv run mkdocs new .

docs.title: FastAPI Image
docs.text:
# Setup environment
uv init --package vlewicki
cd vlewicki
uv add 'fastapi[standard]'

# main.py
from vlewicki import app

# Dockerfile
FROM alpine:latest
RUN apk add python3 uv

WORKDIR /app
COPY ./pyproject.toml \
    ./uv.lock \
    ./.python-version \
    ./main.py \
    ./README.md \
    ./

COPY ./src \
    /app/src

RUN uv sync

CMD ["uv", "run", "fastapi", "run", "--host", "0.0.0.0"]

# Building image
docker build -t vlewicki:0.1.0 .
docker run --rm -p 8000:8000 vlewicki:0.1.0
